scope: Desktop Node comparison of the pinned original, retained v0.33 adapter and v0.34 candidate, optionally including the retained initial v0.34 implementation. Four warmups and 15 rotating samples per graph. Authored folding makes 75,776 calls per sample over 147 authored payloads plus birth and four powers. Other samples make 32,768 native calls across 64 actors. Resource gains mix positive, nonpositive and dead requests. Ward dispatch includes native power queries, maximum life, resource gain, cues and rider dispatch; live-rate samples also include changing stat writes. Actor/world setup, forced GC and complete receipt construction are excluded. Fold result storage, gain accumulation and ward RNG observation are included. No renderer, device, FPS, allocation-volume or peak-memory claim.
